data.name: Shift Form Stain
data.description: When you are struck by a confirmed critical hit and aren't in your shifted form, you must attempt a Will save (DC %1). If you fail, you automatically shift form on your next turn without attempting a check. This consumes one use of that ability. You must also attempt this save if you take damage equal to or greater than your manifestation level while not in combat or before you've acted in combat.|15+LycanthropyManifestationLevel
